title: Exporting Datasets to SPSS
text: psyc350data datasets can exported SPSS .sav files full metadata — variable labels, value labels, user-defined missing values. useful need work SPSS lab assignments.

title: Exporting Datasets to SPSS
code: library(psyc350data) library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: 'dplyr' #> The following objects are masked from 'package:stats': #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from 'package:base': #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union

title: Exporting Datasets to SPSS
text: dataset export function. Just call file path: don’t provide path, file saved current working directory default name.
code: # Each dataset has a dedicated export function export_superman_sav("superman_data.sav") export_superman_smes_sav("superman_smes_data.sav") export_hot_ones_sav("hot_ones_data.sav") export_tip_jokes_sav("tip_jokes_data.sav") export_mcu_sav("mcu_data.sav") export_mock_jury_sav("mock_jury_data.sav") export_candy_sav("candy_data.sav") export_candy_simple_sav("candy_simple_data.sav") export_football_sav("football_data.sav") export_huskers_sav("huskers_data.sav") export_interpersonal_sav("interpersonal_data.sav") export_selfdescriptive_sav("selfdescriptive_data.sav")  # Save to a specific location export_superman_sav("~/Desktop/superman_data.sav") export_football_sav("~/Desktop/football_data.sav")

title: Exporting Datasets to SPSS
text: can also use export_sav() dataset name:
code: # Save to your desktop export_sav("superman", path = "~/Desktop/superman_data.sav")  # Save to the current working directory (default) export_sav("mock_jury") # Creates: mock_jury_data.sav

title: Exporting Datasets to SPSS
text: Sometimes need variables dataset. can use dplyr::select() choose specific columns, pass result export_sav(): exported .sav file contain selected variables, labels metadata preserved.
code: # Export only selected variables from the superman dataset superman |>   select(num, media, year, type, clark_height, rt_critics_score) |>   export_sav(path = "superman_subset.sav")  # Export demographic and scale variables from interpersonal data interpersonal_data |>   select(age, gender, race, gcb, risc, lsas) |>   export_sav(path = "interpersonal_subset.sav")  # Use tidyselect helpers for flexible selection huskers |>   select(date, season, opp, result, starts_with("ne_score"), starts_with("ne_rush")) |>   export_sav(path = "huskers_nebraska_only.sav")  # Select by column position or range mock_jury |>   select(attr, crime, years, phyattr:happy) |>   export_sav(path = "mock_jury_subset.sav")

title: Exporting Datasets to SPSS
text: Use export_all_sav() export every dataset : creates one .sav file per dataset:
code: # Create a folder with all .sav files export_all_sav(dir = "~/Desktop/PSYC350_SPSS/") PSYC350_SPSS/ ├── superman_data.sav ├── superman_smes_data.sav ├── hot_ones_data.sav ├── tip_jokes_data.sav ├── mcu_data.sav ├── mock_jury_data.sav ├── candy_data.sav ├── candy_simple_data.sav ├── football_data.sav ├── huskers_data.sav ├── interpersonal_data.sav └── selfdescriptive_data.sav
